rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AB label, but the image itself is somewhat indistinct; statements such as a clearly visible compact ICM at 6-7 o'clock, excellent symmetry, and a large well-expanded blastocoel are somewhat overconfident relative to what is plainly visible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, male factor diagnosis, BMI, lifestyle, prior cycle history, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to morphology and patient age; minor issues include some speculative quantitative adjustments and overstatement of certainty from limited image detail.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, especially SET in a young good-prognosis patient; minor deviations include speculative use of ERA/DFI and some unsupported numeric claims.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer management, luteal support considerations, when to consider freeze-all, and contingency planning for future cycles.
